title: Pip's Snug Spot
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 continues (Learning), 67-sound stage (sl, sm, sn, sp just added).

pages.text: Pip is in the big barn.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow perched inside a big wooden barn, rain visible through the open door.
The inside of the barn lit dimly, rain streaking past the open doorway.
Pip the sparrow carrying a flat wood chip in his beak across the barn floor.

pages.text: Pip gets a bit of moss.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow carrying a small clump of moss in his beak.
Pip the sparrow carrying a small pale shell in his beak.
Pip the sparrow pulling at a small red cloth rag with his beak.

pages.text: Pip picks a spot to sit.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow settling into a dry corner of the barn among straw.

pages.text: It is snug in the spot.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow arranging the chip, moss, shell and rag into a cosy little pile.

pages.text: Pip naps in the snug spot.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow sleeping peacefully in his snug corner of the barn.
